features.name: rssi_mean_dbm
features.calculation: Mean of connected RSSI samples in the last ten slots; null if none.

features.name: rtt_mean_ms
features.calculation: Mean of successful nonce-matched UDP echo RTTs in the window; null if none.

features.name: rtt_std_ms
features.calculation: Population standard deviation of successful RTTs; zero for one, null for none.

features.name: probe_failure_rate
features.calculation: Failed or disconnected slots divided by all ten slots. Endpoint reachability, not network-wide packet loss.

features.name: disconnect_count
features.calculation: Observed station disconnect events in the window, saturated at 65535.

features.name: success_age_ms
features.calculation: Age since last successful echo, capped at 60000; null before any success.

features.name: connection_uptime_s
features.calculation: Current continuous IP connection uptime, capped at one day; zero when disconnected.
